tasks.prompt: In src/viewer.html, when the browser has no File System Access API, the Open folder button fails silently. Show a one-line hint under the button that says to drag the session folder onto the page instead. Keep the existing style; run npm test.

tasks.name: list-json
tasks.prompt: Add --format json to `glassbox list` in src/cli.mjs (an array of {id, mtime, size, project, title}), with a test in test/cli.test.mjs. Run npm test.

tasks.name: since-weeks

tasks.name: docs-tail
